description: This file implements a media player class for Miracast streaming using GStreamer on Amlogic SoCs. It manages creation and control of the GStreamer pipeline, handles bus messages, and includes functionalities for seeking, statistics, and playback state notifications.

classes.name: SoC_GstPlayer
classes.description: Main class managing GStreamer pipeline for Miracast playback; includes singleton instance management, pipeline creation, playback control, and callbacks.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys the singleton instance, stopping playback if necessary.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Initializes and starts streaming from given IP and port, optionally associating with rtsp_instance.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback by changing the pipeline state.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes media playback by setting the pipeline to playing state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and releases all GStreamer resources, cleaning up the pipeline.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position (in seconds) in the stream.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the total duration of the media in seconds.

methods.name: getCurrentPosition
methods.description: Returns the current playback position in seconds.

methods.name: print_pipeline_state
methods.description: Logs the current and pending state of the pipeline.

methods.name: get_player_statistics
methods.description: Retrieves and logs statistics such as frames rendered and dropped.

methods.name: createPipeline
methods.description: Constructs and configures the GStreamer pipeline, including all elements and their properties.

methods.name: busMessageCb
methods.description: Callback to handle messages from GStreamer bus, such as errors, EOS, buffering, and state changes.

methods.name: pad_added_handler
methods.description: Handles dynamic pad creation for TS demuxer, linking audio and video pads.

methods.name: onFirstVideoFrameCallback
methods.description: Notifies when the first video frame is decoded.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notifies the RTSP instance of playback state changes.

methods.name: playbackThread
methods.description: Dedicated thread function to run the main GStreamer loop.

methods.name: monitor_player_statistics_thread
methods.description: Thread function to periodically retrieve player statistics.

methods.name: changePipelineState
methods.description: Changes the pipeline state with proper error checking.
